coreAttributes.name: 毛线球
coreAttributes.description: 一长段连续交错的羊毛纤维，被紧紧包裹成团。
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name]紧紧攥住毛线球，准备好丢出去了。
coreAttributes.onHitEffect: #IF(npc2.getRace()==RACE_CAT_MORPH && npc2.getRaceStage()==RACE_STAGE_GREATER) [##npc2.setHealth(0)] [npc2.Name] immediately [npc2.verb(fix)] [npc2.her] gaze on the ball of yarn as it rolls across the floor. After lowering [npc2.herself] down into a stalking posture, [npc2.she] suddenly [npc2.verb(pounce)] on the yarn, and after letting out a happy meow, [npc2.she] [npc2.verb(start)] pawing and playing with it, leaving [npc2.herHim] completely vulnerable and [style.italicsExcellent(utterly defeated)]! #ENDIF

hitDescriptions.hitText: [npc.Name]向着[npc2.name]丢出了毛线球，击中了[npc2.herHim]的胸口正中！
[npc.Name]把毛线球向着[npc2.name]丢出去，击中了[npc2.herHim]的[npc.arm(true)]！
[npc.Name]快步上前，用毛线球投向[npc2.name]，成功击中了[npc2.herHim]！

missDescriptions.missText: [npc.Name]向着[npc2.name]丢出了毛线球，但没能命中！
[npc.Name]把毛线球向着[npc2.name]丢出去，却没能命中目标，懊恼地叫了一声！
[npc.Name]快步上前，用毛线球投向[npc2.name]，但却丢歪了！

oneShotEndTurnRecoveryDescriptions.recoveryText: The ball of yarn bounces back towards [npc.name], allowing [npc.herHim] to pick it up and reuse it!
